description: This file defines a class 'ApRadioVbssCapabilities' and a nested structure 'sVbssSettings' related to wireless radio capabilities, including TLV (Type-Length-Value) mappings, within the 'wfa_map' namespace. It specifies the data types, associated constants, and bit field configurations for handling VBSS (Virtual Basic Service Set) capabilities in a wireless environment.

classes.name: ApRadioVbssCapabilities
classes.description: Class representing VBSS capabilities of a radio, including TLV type, radio UID, maximum VBSS count, and settings.

classes.name: sVbssSettings
classes.description: Structure holding bit field configurations for VBSS behaviors, including subtract logic, BSSID restrictions, and fixed bits restrictions.
